programme.desc: In this sequel, the use of land abutting the wilderness sparks conflict for Fog (who owns the land) and Jack. Rather than drill for oil, Fog says he'll open a natural spring-water business, but Jack doesn't believe him, and ends up being jailed for sabotaging the operation.

programme.title: Generation Gap
programme.desc: A rebellious teen (Alex Black) reluctantly spends the summer with his strict war-veteran grandfather (Ed Asner). While the two clash at first, they soon bring about positive changes in each other that lead to new friendships and experiences. Rue McClanahan, Catherine Mary Stewart, Ralph Waite. Directed by Bill L. Norton.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie three years later: being a single mother after her husband Willie was shot during a poker scuffle. She and Maddy move back in with her parents Clark and Marty. She finds a new home, and finds a new teaching position that she settles right into, but Missie has lost all faith in herself, until a chance encounter at her father's church where she adopts homeless orphan Belinda Marshall.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: To save his family bakery, a Bronx baker (Costas Mandylor) with a flair for pastries partners with a talented Manhattan pastry chef (Lauren Holly) to enter a dessert competition with a $250,000 grand prize. Uncle Fabrizio: David Proval. Jim: Bruce Thomas. Jacques Du Jacques: Andy Lauer.

programme.title: Advance And Retreat
programme.desc: An ambitious junior executive is reunited with her first love at a corporate retreat and ultimately realizes that she might have to take a step back to make a leap forward.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Tale of a widower (James Earl Jones) who's determined to make a reading room available in the tough inner-city neighborhood where he and his wife grew up. Joanna Cassidy, Tim Reid, Georg Stanford Brown (who also directed).

programme.title: Relative Stranger
programme.desc: After the death of his father, a former football hero who abandoned his family returns home after six years. His mother tries to mediate the conflict stirred up by his return as he faces his wife and children, whom he left behind.

programme.title: Soda Springs

Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: Reluctant Nanny
programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.title: Legally Tender
programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

programme.title: A View from Here
programme.desc: A journalist (Laura Leighton) returns to her rural hometown to visit her ailing mother (Angie Dickinson) and discovers that many of the area's farmers are selling their land to a casino developer because of an extreme drought. Directed by Stephen W. Bridgewater.

programme.title: The Flower Girl
programme.desc: A young florist and wedding planner suddenly goes from being single and unlucky at love, to dating two fantastic men, and is forced to make a life-altering decision about her fundamental values about love and family.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.title: After the Fall
programme.desc: A talented equestrian (Andrea Bowen) is paralyzed after an accident and must go through physical therapy in hopes of someday walking again. During the recovery process, she befriends a rough-around-the-edges patient (Fiona Dourif) and her neighbor (Rick Malambri), a former rodeo cowboy who encourages her to return to horseback riding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Diagnosis Delicious
programme.desc: A disgraced chef and an ambitious cardiologist who can't even boil water cross paths when she takes his cooking class. Now she must convince the hot-headed chef to teach her hospital's new Healthy Living seminars, but he has another idea.

programme.title: Undercover Angel
programme.desc: A young girl prays for an angel to help her mother restore their home. But they get more than what they bargained for.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Resting Place
programme.desc: Story about a major (John Lithgow) who battles racism while trying to bury a black Vietnam hero in an all-white cemetery. Luther: Morgan Freeman. Ada: C.C.H. Pounder. Eudora: Frances Sternhagen. Sam: G.D. Spradlin. Sarge: M. Emmet Walsh. Hauer: Richard Bradford. Directed on location by John Korty.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: An aspiring screenwriter pretends to date a starlet who's trying to make her ex jealous. As the duo keep up their ruse, the lines between fact and fiction begin to blur and romantic entanglements ensue.

programme.title: Uncorked
programme.desc: A workaholic (Julie Benz) finds herself in unfamiliar territory after her schedule unexpectedly clears during a business trip to California's wine country. Directed by David Cass Sr.

programme.desc: After years of hiring housekeepers to run his home, a single advertising executive loses his job and becomes a stay-at-home dad. His new role gives him a different perspective on his family, but a tempting job offer threatens to lead him back to his old workaholic ways.

programme.title: The Seven Year Hitch
programme.desc: A slacker tries to prevent his best friend and roommate from marrying the wrong man by claiming their seven-year cohabitation makes them common-law spouses.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Casa Vita
programme.desc: An Iowa farmer who moved to LA to attend a major league baseball camp romances the chef at the restaurant where he works. His future looks bright until an injury threatens his dream.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Audrey Tautou. They become embroiled in a deadly conspiracy that has shattering ramifications for Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on Dan Brown's forerunner to The Da Vinci Code, starring Tom Hanks and Ayelet Zurer. With the election of a new pope imminent, the Illuminati kidnap the four leading contenders and issue a coded message that they will murder the men and blow up the Vatican. Catholic leaders turn to Harvard symbolist Robert Langdon, who must put his uneasy relationship with the church hierarchy aside in an effort to crack the code and save the men's lives.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestseller by Dan Brown, starring Tom Hanks and Felicity Jones. Renowned symbologist Dr Robert Langdon wakes up in a Florence hospital with a head injury and no memory of the previous 48 hours. However, he soon finds himself hunted and forced to undertake a globe-trotting race against time to prevent the release of a deadly virus capable of killing half the world's population.

programme.title: Arthur's Whisky
programme.desc: When Joan's husband dies, she discovers he'd invented an anti-aging elixir that literally takes the years off. Sharing it with her friends Linda and Susan, the rejuvenated women waste little time in painting the town red, but they soon realise it's a very different world to the one they remember. Co-writer/director Stephen Cookson's comedy, starring Diane Keaton, Hayley Mills, Patricia Hodge, Lulu and David Harewood.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding 3
programme.desc: Following the death of her father Gus, Toula Portokalos honours his dying wish to take the entire family to his childhood village and reconnect with their Greek roots. Toula's husband Ian joins the madcap expedition along with extended family including her brother Nick and Aunt Voula. Romantic comedy, starring Nia Vardalos and John Corbett.

programme.title: Jules
programme.desc: Residents of a small Pennsylvania town are disturbed when a UFO crashes into a back garden. Director Marc Turtletaub's comedy drama, starring Ben Kingsley, Harriet Harris and Jane Curtin.

programme.desc: Romantic fantasy thriller starring Tom Cruise, Cameron Diaz and Penélope Cruz. After a night of flirtation with the beautiful Sofia, a violent encounter with an obsessive ex-girlfriend leaves playboy David Aames badly disfigured and facing a charge of murder.

programme.title: The Color Purple
programme.desc: Musical adaptation of Alice Walker's novel, starring Fantasia Barrino and Taraji P Henson. In early 20th-century Georgia, young Celie is forced to marry the tyrannical farmer "Mister". For years, Celie's life is bleak and difficult, but when Mister's mistress, the spirited jazz singer Shug Avery, comes to stay, Celie begins to believe in herself.

programme.title: Get Away
programme.desc: A family's holiday to a remote getaway takes a lethal turn when they discover the island they're on is inhabited by a serial killer. Director Steffen Haars' comedy horror, written by and starring Nick Frost, with Aisling Bea and Sebastian Croft.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Co Dublin-born fighter pilot Brendan Finucane, known by his colleagues as Paddy, hones his skills in the RAF during the Second World War, eventually becoming the youngest wing commander in its history. Biographical drama, starring Shane O'Regan, Ryan O'Grady and Sophia Eleni.

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Will Smith, Charlize Theron and Jason Bateman. The life of superhero John Hancock is on the skids; despite having saved countless lives, he's mostly remembered now for destroying property while flying around drunk. But after he rescues PR executive Ray Embrey from the path of a train, Hancock is offered the chance of repairing his tarnished image.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Action spy thriller sequel starring Tom Cruise. Impossible Mission Force agent Ethan Hunt is on the trail of his rogue former colleague Sean Ambrose, following the theft of a synthetic virus capable of wiping out the world's population. In an effort to get closer to Ambrose, Ethan is accompanied on the mission by the renegade agent's former lover.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: High school outcasts Janis Sarkisian and Damian Hubbard narrate the tale of 15-year-old Cady Heron, who moves back to America from Kenya with her mother. Janis encourages Cady to infiltrate the Plastics, ruled by the formidable Regina George, but when she does, the clique soon corrupts the new girl. Musical adaptation of the 2004 cult classic, starring Angourie Rice, Renee Rapp, Auli'i Cravalho, and Tina Fey, who also wrote the screenplay.

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Underwater rescue expert Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. However, a greedy mining operation threatens the team's safety and unleashes a school of voracious 75ft-long megalodon sharks. Director Ben Wheatley's comedy thriller sequel, starring Jason Statham and Cliff Curtis.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Superhero action adventure starring Dakota Johnson. While on a dangerous job, New York paramedic Cassie Webb has a near-fatal accident and develops precognitive powers. When she foresees that three young women are in danger, she sets out to protect them from the super-powered villain who wants them dead.

programme.title: Barbie
programme.desc: Satirical fantasy comedy starring Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling. When blonde and bubbly Barbie experiences a series of sudden crises, she must leave Barbieland to track down her human owner and make things right. But the adoring Ken follows her to Los Angeles where he discovers something called the "patriarchy" and develops some radical ideas...

programme.title: Wonka
programme.desc: Musical comedy prequel to Roald Dahl's Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, starring Timothée Chalamet. Young Willy Wonka yearns to produce his own confectionary, but finds trouble in the form of a shady cartel of chocolatiers and a mysterious thief.

programme.title: Twisters
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Glen Powell. Five years after a storm-chasing tragedy involving a group of her friends, meteorologist Kate joins a team investigating unusual tornado activity in Oklahoma. There, they encounter a rival posse of "tornado wranglers" led by the cocky Tyler, who clashes with Kate as the "twisters" intensify.

programme.title: The Fall Guy
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Ryan Gosling and Emily Blunt. After a shocking on-set accident, stuntman Colt Seavers is taking some time out from the movie game. But when the lead actor vanishes from a film being directed by his old flame Jody Moreno, Seavers is persuaded to help track down the missing star and finds himself drawn into a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Beekeeper
programme.desc: An apparently unassuming man finds someone very important to him has been scammed and driven to harm. Revealed as a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organisation known as 'Beekeepers', he sets out on a brutal quest of vengeance, hunting those responsible for the incident, who have seriously underestimated how much of a threat he is. Action thriller, starring Jason Statham, Jeremy Irons, Minnie Driver and Jemma Redgrave.
